high_level_description: This image captures a nighttime scene at what appears to be an airport terminal, specifically the Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport in Mumbai, India. The terminal building is illuminated with bright lights, showcasing its modern architecture with a large curved roof and glass windows. In the foreground, there are two large, glossy black horse statues adorned with white blankets and bridles. These statues are positioned on a grassy area, adding a decorative element to the scene.
